script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Saying the list is all about who Israel is, rather than what they do, overlooks the commands to walk, serve, and obey.
The surprise-quiz joke invokes a school scenario and jokes about the question itself.
Moses says the LORD chose the descendants of Israel's fathers, meaning Israel, not Israel's descendants.
“Nobody is left to fend alone” goes beyond the statement that the LORD executes justice for the fatherless and widow.
The greeting-card and cookie-box joke makes God's love and provision the subject of the comparison, rather than keeping humor on the human side.
Moses says Israel were foreigners in Egypt; he does not say he is asking them to remember how it felt.
“Seventy people turned into a whole sky” drops the comparison: Moses says Israel became as numerous as the stars.
“I'll just say it plainly and move along” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
“Nothing was left standing for them” goes beyond the households, tents, and living things the passage names.
“I won't joke about it” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
The passage says Israel is about to cross the Jordan, not that they are standing at it.
The rain-fed land is contrasted with irrigation in Egypt, but the text does not say nobody will need to carry a bucket.
Introducing the quote as “Moses says” attributes the first-person promise to Moses. A plain lead-in would avoid assigning the speaker.
Introducing the quote as “Moses says” attributes the first-person promise to Moses. A plain lead-in would avoid assigning the speaker.
“I'll keep it plain” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
“Every day, all day” stretches the specified occasions into a command to speak about the words continuously.
“The whole day, every day” stretches the specified occasions into a command to speak about the words continuously.
The text does not state Moses' desire that Israel choose well; the explanation presents it as fact.
The text gives the mountains' location but does not state that Moses gives the details because he wants Israel to find the mountain.
